t: Which way the need actually runs
a: ۞ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ أَنتُمُ ٱلْفُقَرَآءُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
p: Yā ayyuha-n-nāsu antumu-l-fuqarā'u ila-llāh, wa-llāhu huwa-l-Ghaniyyu-l-Ḥamīd.
m: O mankind, you are those in need of Allāh, while Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
